faqs.q: What is the Blowout Preventer Control Hose Fireshield 5000 used for?
faqs.a: The Blowout Preventer Control Hose Fireshield 5000 is used for BOP control circuits where the hose must survive a fire. It is a well control hose in 1/4" to 1" bore, rated 5000 psi WP, from the Continental range. fire-resistant per API 16D / API RP 17H, withstands 1300°F (704°C) for 30 minutes. For BOP control circuits.

faqs.q: What does the 5000 psi WP rating of the Blowout Preventer Control Hose Fireshield 5000 mean?
faqs.a: The rating is a working pressure (WP), the continuous service rating, so the Blowout Preventer Control Hose Fireshield 5000 is rated 5000 psi WP in 1/4" to 1". The hydrotest is 1.5 times working pressure per the listing; a test pressure is never a working pressure.

faqs.q: What bore sizes does the Blowout Preventer Control Hose Fireshield 5000 come in?
faqs.a: The listing gives 1/4" to 1" inside diameter for the Blowout Preventer Control Hose Fireshield 5000, with crimped end fittings. Sizes outside the range can be quoted with a longer lead time. Give the inside diameter and assembly length on the RFQ.

faqs.q: Should I choose the Blowout Preventer Control Hose Fireshield 5000 or the Hydraulic Conduit Hose?
faqs.a: The Fireshield BOP control hose is built to survive fire to API 16D and API RP 17H, while the hydraulic conduit hose carries subsea control fluid to API 17J in umbilicals. See the [Hydraulic Conduit Hose](/p/hydraulic-conduit-hose).

faqs.q: What is the temperature range of the Blowout Preventer Control Hose Fireshield 5000?

faqs.q: What are the liner and reinforcement of the Blowout Preventer Control Hose Fireshield 5000?
faqs.a: The liner is Hydraulic-fluid-compatible synthetic rubber and the reinforcement is wire braid + fireshield fire-resistant outer armour. faqs.q: What does the 15000 psi WP (API 17J) rating of the Subsea LMRP Hoses for Choke & Kill and Hydraulic Conduit Application mean?

The hydrotest is 1.5 times working pressure per the listing; a test pressure is never a working pressure.
